It's perfectly balanced to be thrown farther than your average spear, able to pierce targets from a great distance.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 6 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Throwing Spear}} Throwing Spears are [[Weapon]]s balanced to be thrown farther than other [[Spear]]s. They are capable of striking [[Enemy|Enemies]] at a great distance. Commonly, they are found in [[Treasure Chest]]s in [[West Necluda]] and [[Hyrule Field]]. Being made of metal, Throwing Spears will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
